tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Trade License issued by competent authority

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Experience certificate/ the bidder should have minimum last 5 years experience to run the canteen in Government hospital/Autonomous institute only
GST registration certificate and GST return file (Copy of Latest)
Professional tax registration certificate and latest returned
Trade License issued by competent authority
Self declaration stating that the firm is not black list and not facing any judicial trial or department enquiry on minimum Rs. 100/- bond paper duly notarized by a notary
Self attested copy of address office & residential and phone no & email id
Co-operative societies have to submit financial soundness certificate issued by competent authority
Valuable FSSAI permission certificate issued by local food safety department
The tender document shall have seal and signature on all pages including the annexure by the authorized signatory
The annual Financial Turnover statements certified by CA/FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26 for minimum 50 lakhs per annum
Pan Card and Adhar card copy
